components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). Optional;
            when present it is combined with the last name to form the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On the response this is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized on create
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized into
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The
            result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned, and duplicate telephones are detected by comparing it.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the 'ageBand' (computed against the
            registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region per the
            fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, permits registering this owner even though another
            owner already belongs to the same household (same last name and
            postcode); it is then recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The flag only bypasses the household
            duplicate block; the householdId itself is always derived from the last
            name and postcode. Optional; defaults to false. This flag is only a
            create-time hint and is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title and last
                name joined by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at read time from the stored E.164
                'telephone', which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name, assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household:
                the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                last name concatenated with '|' and the postcode. Owners with the same
                last name and postcode receive the same value automatically. Always
                assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: A1B2C3D4E5F6
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived at create time. Points start at 0 and
                accumulate: 2 when an email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and
                level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the customerCode (the part
                before the '-'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode, or 'UNKNOWN'
                when no customer code is assigned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality (region)
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the locality
                is not one of those regions.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (i.e.
                already carry the current business day as their registrationDate),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created while
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different
                telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of
                (same last name and postcode, different telephone). Absent when
                possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, the single derived value all duplicate detection
                is based on, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the
                telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is its lower-cased value
                (empty when absent) and the household segment is the householdId (empty when
                the owner does not share a household). A create is rejected with 409 only when
                a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (setting this true) while
                retaining the record, and the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks
                ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:

              title: Customer code
              description: >-

              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-

              readOnly: true

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: A1B2C3D4E5F6
              readOnly: true

              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true

              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-

              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created while
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different
                telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, the single derived value all duplicate detection

              type: string

              readOnly: true

Moved date-derived values to a fiscal-year basis (fiscal year starts **1 July**), driven off the business-day-adjusted `registrationDate`.

**`Owner.java`** (`model/`):
- Added `fiscalYearStart(LocalDate)` helper — returns the calendar year in which the fiscal year containing a date began (July–Dec → same year; Jan–Jun → previous year).
- Added derived `getFiscalYear()` returning `FY<YY>` (e.g. a 2026-08-11 registration → `FY26`).
- `getMembershipNumber()` now uses the **fiscal year's** last two digits for the `-M<YY>` segment instead of the calendar year.
- `getMembershipPoints()` tenure now counts **elapsed fiscal years** (`fiscalYearStart(today) - fiscalYearStart(reg) > 1`) rather than a 365-day window.

**`openapi.yml`**: added the read-only `fiscalYear` property (`^FY[0-9]{2}$`) to the `Owner` schema and updated the `membershipNumber`/`membershipPoints` descriptions to match. MapStruct auto-maps `fiscalYear` since the `Owner` getter matches the generated DTO property.

One deliberate interpretation worth flagging: the spec pins the format (`FY<YY>`) and the 1 July start but not the labelling convention or the exact tenure threshold. I labelled the fiscal year by the calendar year it **begins** in, and translated the old "tenure exceeds 365 days" rule to "more than one elapsed fiscal year." Only the `FY\d{2}` regex is test-enforced; if your business convention labels FYs by their **ending** year, or wants tenure to award points at ≥1 elapsed fiscal year, those two lines are where to adjust.
